metadata.notice: Entirely fictional fixture. No real town, utility, account, incident, post, or media is represented. Do not treat this scenario as evidence of a real public-safety event or fetch its URL.
metadata.scenario: Coordinated false emergency claim about a fictional Meridian Vale water plant
expected_signals: one origin post followed by 15 near-simultaneous exact-copy bot posts
five high-follower accounts amplify the same claim after the initial burst
one repeated media_hash supports a perceptual-hash matching demo
one deceptive, non-routable-in-practice demo URL shown as text only
